question.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
question.subtitle: If you are unable to use online queries, you can directly call our 24-hour customer service hotline and provide your tracking number. Our customer service team will assist you with the inquiry and answer any related questions. For special transportation situations, such as international shipping or multi-stop transshipment, we will also send SMS or email reminders regularly to ensure you are always informed about the status of your goods.

contents.question: How do you ensure the safety of the cargo during loading and unloading?
contents.answer: We implement strict safety measures during every loading and unloading process. Our staff are professionally trained and use high-quality protective equipment such as straps, pads, and non-slip mats to secure the cargo. We also conduct regular vehicle inspections to ensure their condition is optimal and minimize the risk of damage.

contents.question: What should I do if the cargo is damaged during transport?
contents.answer: We are committed to ensuring the integrity of the cargo. In the event of any accidental damage during transport, we offer compensation protection and will work with you to identify the cause of the issue. Please ensure that you inspect the cargo and take photos before loading and unloading to facilitate the claim process.

contents.question: What measures are in place to prevent injuries during loading and unloading?
contents.answer: We strictly follow industry safety standards to ensure that all operators wear the necessary safety equipment and undergo regular safety training. During loading and unloading processes, we adhere to proper operational procedures and use mechanical assistance to minimize manual handling, thereby ensuring the safety of our workers.

contents.question: How do you ensure that goods arrive on time and quickly?
contents.answer: We use an efficient transportation network and optimized route planning to ensure that each shipment is delivered in the shortest possible time. We collaborate with multiple transport companies to provide flexible scheduling solutions and track the location of each vehicle in real-time to ensure timely delivery.

contents.question: How do you guarantee fast transport if there are traffic jams or unforeseen delays?
contents.answer: Our transportation team monitors traffic conditions in real-time and takes alternate routes when necessary to avoid delays. Additionally, we have an emergency response mechanism in place to quickly adjust transport plans and minimize any delays, ensuring that the goods are delivered as quickly as possible.

advantages.subtitle: International Road Transportation
advantages.title: Advantages of International Road Transportation
advantages.more: SJIUS owns 100 heavy-duty freight trucks dedicated to international road transport services. Our business covers transport management, warehousing, customs clearance, and documentation processing, ensuring efficient and reliable supply chain management to meet the comprehensive needs of customers and the market.
advantages.description: International road transportation is trusted by customers for its efficiency, flexibility, and cost-effectiveness. With an extensive transport network, we achieve fast cross-border delivery without transshipment, offering direct point-to-point service that saves time and reduce costs. Compared to other transportation methods, road transport provides route flexibility, allowing for tailored adjustments to meet customer needs. Using advanced GPS tracking technology, we monitor goods in real-time to ensure safety. Whether for small shipments or bulk transportation, we meet diverse needs and empower businesses to efficiently connect with global markets.

features.title: TIR International Transport Certification
features.description: We hold TIR international transport certification, allowing us to provide efficient cross-border transportation services. Through the TIR system, goods can be transported directly to their destination in a sealed state, eliminating the need for intermediate inspections. This significantly reduces customs clearance procedures and time, thereby enhancing transportation efficiency. Additionally, TIR certification minimizes potential extra costs during transport, saving money for our customers. Whether for international trade or cross-border logistics, our professional and efficient services help clients achieve seamless goods flow and fast delivery to meet global transport demands.

features.title: Professional Team
features.description: We have a highly experienced and professional team dedicated to delivering premium logistics services. Our rigorously trained team members excel in international transport regulations and processes, effectively managing complex logistics challenges. From solution design to transport execution, we monitor every step to ensure each shipment arrives safely and on time. Whether for customs clearance, warehousing, or specialized cargo transport, we provide tailored solutions with professionalism and precision to support your business growth, positioning ourselves as a trusted logistics partner.

features.title: Port Consolidation Warehouse
features.description: We specialize in providing professional port consolidation warehouse services, creating efficient and convenient logistics solutions. Located in prime port areas with excellent facilities, our consolidation warehouses support temporary storage, sorting, distribution, and transit of goods to ensure a smooth cargo flow. Our services cover various freight modes and offer flexible storage terms, intelligent management systems, and a professional warehousing team to ensure the safety of the cargo. Whether for import/export transit or regional cargo distribution, we provide reliable and efficient storage solutions.

features.title: International Door-to-Door Service
features.description: We specialize in providing professional door-to-door international logistics services, covering the entire transportation process from origin to destination. Our services include front-end pickup to a (self-operated) consolidation warehouse, port customs declaration and transit, cross-border transportation, (self-operated) warehouse pre-clearance preparation to customs supervised warehouses, destination customs clearance, and final delivery to the recipient.

hero.title: Supply Chain Financial Services
hero.description:
We provide comprehensive financial services for import and export trading companies, helping businesses optimize capital management and improve operational efficiency.

With extensive industry experience and strong financial support, we offer flexible financing solutions to ensure our clients receive the best funding support in the global market. Our financial services include car purchase advances, door-to-door freight charges, export tax rebates, and import duties. These services are designed to help businesses reduce financial risks, enhance liquidity, and facilitate smooth cross-border transactions.

items.title: Funding for Vehicle Purchases
items.description: We provide vehicle purchase financing solutions. After clients pay the purchase deposit, we offer funding for vehicle purchases and arrange delivery to the destination. Clients only need to pay the remaining balance before picking up the vehicle.

items.title: Shipping Charges
items.description: We offer transportation financing services, advancing international freight costs and providing door-to-door freight payment solutions. Clients only need to pay the freight charges in full before picking up vehicles.

items.title: Export Tax Rebate
items.description: We provide export tax rebate financing services for the automotive industry, helping clients recover export tax rebate funds in advance.

items.title: Import Duty Solutions
items.description: We provide financing services in destination countries to assist clients with import duty payments. Clients only need to pay the import duties at the time of vehicle pick-up.

whyChooseUs.title: We offer professional freight financial services, including vehicle purchase financing, door-to-door freight charges, export tax rebates, and import duties. Our comprehensive support helps clients operate efficiently, reduce costs, and enhance competitiveness!

Choosing us and enjoy worry-free, efficient services!

cards.title: Vehicle Inspection Services
cards.description: We provide professional and efficient vehicle inspection services to ensure smooth and secure logistics transportation. We conduct  thorough inspections throughout the entire vehicle gate-in and gate-out process to ensure flawless operations. Our services include exterior inspections, functionality tests and cargo safety inspections to guarantee each vehicle is delivered in its optimal condition.

cards.title: Document Preparation
cards.description: We provide a full range of vehicle-related documentation services at exporting ports with proper storage and classification of relevant documents according to international transportation requirements. We guarantee the completeness of exporters’ documents for customs clearance and tax refunds, thereby enhancing the overall trade efficiency.

cards.title: Vehicle Maintenance
cards.description: Our services in vehicle supervised warehouses include vehicle washing, charging, refueling, tire pressure checks and periodic vehicle start-ups, ensuring that vehicles stored in warehouses are kept in their optimal condition. The team conducts regular checks on the battery, fuel levels, and tire pressure to ensure each vehicle is ready for use at any time. Moreover, vehicles are periodically started to maintain engine health and prevent potential issues. This comprehensive maintenance contributes to extending vehicle’s lifespan, ensuring its performance and safety.
